note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-24): 15 pictures from 30 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured; the bow in the cloud is shown as the text's own image (first used here, saved from Genesis 6 to 8), with the same ark as in Genesis 6 to 8, and Noah and his sons only as ordinary people of today. Noah's drunkenness and nakedness are never shown: only a tipped wine jug by the tent, the son telling his brothers, and the two brothers seen from inside the tent holding the cloak spread with their backs to it. His death is shown by an empty chair with the cloak folded on it.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: God blessed Noah and his sons to fill the earth, put the fear of them on every creature and gave them every living thing for food as he gave the green plants, but not flesh with its blood; he will demand an account for every human life, because humankind is made in the image of God.
ideas: A young couple with a baby stand on a hilltop looking out over a vast empty green land of valleys and rivers to the horizon
A big family of many generations walks out together across a wide green land toward far valleys
A herd of deer lifts their heads and bounds away at the edge of a wood as a man walks into the meadow
A fisherman hauls a net heavy with silver fish into his boat at morning
A rustic farmhouse table laid with fish, roast meat, bread, vegetables, green herbs and fruit together
A family about to eat at an outdoor table of grilled fish and green salad
People of every age and people on a crowded street, each face distinct
A newborn's tiny hand gripping a grown man's finger
A mother and father face to face with their newborn held up between them
Children filling a playground

sections.meaning: God establishes his covenant with Noah, his offspring and every living creature: never again will a flood destroy the earth.
ideas: A family of eight stands at the edge of a calm lake together with many animals, all at peace in morning sun
A calm river winding gently through green farmland and villages, safe within its banks
A father's hand and a child's hand clasped, animals grazing behind
A family and a deer both drinking at the same calm stream
The ark empty on the mountain above a green valley
Gentle rain falling on a field with no harm
A dove nesting in a tree by the water
A handshake over a farm gate
A boat pulled up on a dry shore, rope coiled
Animals and people together under one clearing sky

sections.meaning: God sets his bow in the cloud as the sign of his everlasting covenant with the earth and every living creature: when the bow is seen in the cloud, he will remember.
ideas: A bright full rainbow arches across clearing storm clouds over a green valley, the ark resting small on the mountain
A full rainbow arches over farmland and grazing sheep under dark clouds
A family on a farmhouse porch after a storm, seen from behind, looking up at a rainbow across the dark cloud
A rainbow bright against a dark storm cloud over a city, wet streets shining
A deer and her fawn in a wet meadow under a rainbow
Flocks of birds crossing in front of a rainbow over a meadow with horses
A child pointing up at a rainbow
A rainbow reflected in a still lake
Raindrops on a leaf catching rainbow colours
A rainbow over the sea after a storm

sections.meaning: From Noah's three sons the people of the whole earth spread out.
ideas: Seen from behind on a hilltop, three grown brothers stand where one road splits into three, each road winding off to a far valley
Three men walk away from each other along three roads, each with his family and pack animals
Three rivers flowing out from one spring
A tree trunk splitting into three great branches
Three families' camps spreading over three valleys
Three brothers embracing before parting
Footpaths fanning out across a plain
Three caravans heading to three horizons
A crowd of the world's peoples
Seeds blowing away from one dandelion

sections.meaning: Noah planted a vineyard, got drunk and lay uncovered in his tent; Ham saw and told his brothers, but Shem and Japheth walked in backward with a cloak and covered their father without looking.
ideas: A grey-haired man planting young grapevines in rows on a sunny hillside
New rows of young vines on a terraced hillside beside a tent
Outside a tent at evening an empty wine jug lies tipped over beside an overturned cup, the flap half open, dark inside
A wine cup knocked over on a rough table inside a tent, red wine spilled, a lamp burning low
Outside a tent at evening a young man points back at the tent as he tells his two brothers
Seen from behind, a young man holds a tent flap open, looking into the dark
Two grown brothers walk backward toward a tent door, a cloak spread between them on their shoulders, faces turned away
Seen from inside a dim tent, two men back in through the door holding a cloak spread between them, faces turned away to the light
Two pairs of hands lowering a blanket
A cloak lying folded on a stool by a tent

sections.meaning: Noah woke and knew what his youngest son had done; he cursed Canaan to be a slave to his brothers, and blessed Yahweh the God of Shem, and Japheth.
ideas: At dawn an old grey-haired man sits in the doorway of his tent with the cloak around his shoulders, his face grave, an empty jug beside him
An old man at his tent door speaks with one hand raised to his sons: two stand close, a third stands apart
An old man's hands laid on two bowed heads
Two tents side by side and a third pitched far off
A father turning his face away from one son
A broken wine jug on the ground at morning
An old man staring at the empty cup in his hand

A father with arms around two sons
Chains (no: too violent)

sections.meaning: Noah lived three hundred and fifty years after the flood, nine hundred and fifty years in all, and he died.
ideas: High on a mountainside the ark's old weathered timbers lie grey and broken, overgrown with grass and flowers, while the valleys below are full of farms, vineyards and villages

An old vineyard grown wild

A grave of stones on a hillside

An hourglass emptied

A grandchild's hand on an old man's hand

scenes.principle: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and he said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.
scenes.shows: Seen from a hill, a big family of many generations walks out together across a wide green land toward far valleys.
scenes.prompt: Seen from a hill above, a big family of many generations, grandparents, parents and many children, ordinary people of today in plain clothes, walks out together across a wide green land toward far valleys and the open horizon in morning light, no town or house anywhere. The family and the wide land are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the fear of you and the terror of you will be on every wild animal of the earth and on every bird of the sky; with everything that creeps on the ground and with all the fish of the sea, into your hand they are given.
scenes.shows: A herd of deer lifts their heads and bounds away at the edge of a wood, and birds take off, as a man walks into the meadow.
scenes.prompt: At the edge of a wood, a herd of deer in a meadow lift their heads in alarm and begin to bound away, and a flock of birds takes off from the grass, as a man in plain clothes walks into the meadow from the side of the frame, seen from behind. The fleeing deer and the birds are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: Every moving thing that is alive will be yours for food; like the green plants, I give you everything. "Only flesh with its life, its blood, you must not eat.
scenes.shows: A rustic farmhouse table laid with fish, roast meat, bread, vegetables, green herbs and fruit together.
scenes.prompt: A long rustic wooden farmhouse table by a sunny window, laid with plates of grilled fish and roast meat side by side with bread, green vegetables, fresh herbs and bowls of fruit. The laden table is in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And surely the blood of your lives I will demand; from the hand of every living thing I will demand it, and from the hand of humankind, from the hand of each one's brother, I will demand the life of humankind. Whoever sheds the blood of humankind, by humankind his blood will be shed, for in the image of God he made humankind.
scenes.shows: A newborn baby's tiny hand grips a grown man's finger.
scenes.prompt: Close view of a newborn baby's tiny hand gripping tightly around one finger of a grown man's large hand, soft warm light, a blanket blurred behind. The two hands are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And God said to Noah and to his sons with him, saying, "And as for me, look, I am about to establish my covenant with you and with your offspring after you, and with every living creature that is with you—the birds, the livestock, and every wild animal of the earth with you—of all that went out of the ark, to every living thing of the earth. And I will establish my covenant with you, and never again will all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood, and never again will there be a flood to ruin the earth."
scenes.shows: A family of eight stands at the edge of a calm lake together with many animals, all at peace in the morning sun.
scenes.prompt: In a green valley after rain, a family of eight ordinary people of today in plain clothes, an older grey-haired couple, three grown sons and their wives, stand at the edge of a calm lake together with many animals, deer, sheep, horses, a fox, and birds on the branches, all at peace in the morning sun. The family, the animals and the lake are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant that I am setting between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for everlasting generations: my bow I have set in the cloud, and it will serve as a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
scenes.shows: A bright full rainbow arches across clearing storm clouds over a green valley, the ark resting small on the mountain.
scenes.prompt: A bright, full rainbow arches across dark clearing storm clouds over a wide green valley washed by rain. On a mountainside under the rainbow, the ark, an enormous plain wooden vessel shaped like a long rectangular box, three decks high, its hull coated in black pitch, with a low pitched roof, a row of small openings for light just under the roof, and one large door in its side rests, small and far off. The rainbow and the clouds fill the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And when I bring cloud over the earth and the bow is seen in the cloud, I will remember my covenant that is between me and you and every living creature among all flesh, and never again will the waters become a flood to ruin all flesh.
scenes.shows: Seen from behind, a family on a farmhouse porch after a storm looks up at a rainbow across the dark cloud.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, a family of ordinary people of today, a father, a mother and two children, stand on the porch of a farmhouse after a storm, looking up at a bright rainbow across a dark cloud over the fields. The rainbow and the family are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the bow will be in the cloud, and I will see it, to remember an everlasting covenant between God and every living creature among all flesh that is on the earth." And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth."
scenes.shows: A deer and her fawn stand in a wet meadow under a rainbow.
scenes.prompt: A deer and her young fawn stand in a wet, shining meadow after rain, and above them a bright rainbow arches across a dark cloud. The deer, the fawn and the rainbow are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem and Ham and Japheth. Now Ham was the father of Canaan. These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the people of the whole earth scattered.
scenes.shows: Three men walk away from each other along three roads, each with his family and pack animals.
scenes.prompt: Seen from above on a wide plain, three dirt roads fan out from one point, and along each a small group walks away toward a different horizon: a man with his family and a few pack animals on each road. The three roads and the groups are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Noah, the man of the ground, made a beginning and planted a vineyard.
scenes.shows: A grey-haired man kneels planting young grapevines in rows on a sunny hillside.
scenes.prompt: A grey-haired man in plain work clothes kneels on a sunny hillside planting a young grapevine in the earth, with new rows of young vines already planted on stakes behind him. The man and the rows of vines are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And he drank some of the wine and became drunk, and he uncovered himself inside his tent.
scenes.shows: Outside a tent at evening, an empty clay wine jug lies tipped over beside an overturned cup, the tent flap half open and dark inside.
scenes.prompt: Outside a large plain tent of woven cloth at evening, an empty clay wine jug lies tipped over on the ground beside an overturned cup and a dark red stain of spilled wine; the tent's door flap hangs half open, dark inside. The jug, the cup and the tent door are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and he told his two brothers outside.
scenes.shows: Outside a tent at evening, a young man points back at the tent as he tells his two older brothers.
scenes.prompt: Outside a large plain tent of woven cloth at evening, a young man in plain clothes points back over his shoulder at the closed tent while he talks to his two older brothers, who turn to listen with troubled faces. The three young men and the tent are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Shem and Japheth took the cloak and put it on the shoulders of the two of them, and they walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father, and their faces were turned backward, and the nakedness of their father they did not see.
scenes.shows: Seen from inside a dim tent, two men back in through the door holding a cloak spread between them, faces turned away out to the light.
scenes.prompt: Seen from inside a dim tent, two grown men back in through the bright doorway, holding a large woven cloak spread wide between them, their faces turned away from us and out toward the daylight behind them. The two men, the cloak and the bright doorway are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Noah awoke from his wine, and he knew what his youngest son had done to him. And he said, "Cursed is Canaan. A slave of slaves he will be to his brothers."
scenes.shows: An old man at his tent door speaks with one hand raised to his sons: two stand close before him, a third stands apart.
scenes.prompt: In morning light at the door of a large plain tent of woven cloth, an old grey-haired man in plain clothes stands and speaks with one hand raised toward his grown sons: two of them stand close before him with heads bowed, and a third stands apart at a distance, looking away. The old man and his sons are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Noah lived three hundred and fifty years after the flood. And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years, and he died.
scenes.shows: An empty wooden chair by a tent door at sunset, a cloak folded on it, vineyards on the hill below.
scenes.prompt: An empty, worn wooden chair stands by the door of a large plain tent of woven cloth at sunset, a woven cloak folded on its seat, and below it rows of old grapevines run down the hillside into a quiet valley. The empty chair and the vineyard are in the upper part of the frame. The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
